create_audio_classification_task: create an AudioClassificationTask instance with AudioClassificationConfig to set up audio classification
load_target_dictionary: load a target dictionary from a dict file for audio classification labels
load_dataset_with_labels: load an audio dataset split with corresponding label files for classification training
run_train_step: run a training step that computes loss and logs accuracy metrics for audio classification
compute_classification_metrics: compute classification metrics including correct predictions and total samples during inference
